place.name: Temppeliaukio Church
place.description: Temppeliaukio Church (Finnish: Temppeliaukion kirkko; Swedish: Tempelplatsens kyrka), also known as the Church of the Rock or Rock Church, is an Evangelical Lutheran church in the Töölö district of Helsinki, Finland. Designed by architect brothers Timo and Tuomo Suomalainen, the church was completed in 1969 and is built directly into the natural granite bedrock of Temppeliaukio (“Temple Square”).
